decision: The maintained source journey and rebuilt extracted customer package are documentation-ready within the explicitly static and local evidence scope. No material product-truth, procedure, path, licensing-candor, source/package-parity, or rendered-layout defect remains.

exclusions: Fresh-host installation, discovery, enabled state, invocation, and model behavior

checks.evidence: HEAD and RELEASE-MANIFEST.json identify checkpoint 6151da1862c93e2af1755a5b79aee239816c5d1f; the manifest records tracked_source_clean=true.
Independent rerun observed 25 visible roots, 16 Faculty Cores, 131 customer references, no findings, and redistribution_state=blocked_pending_component_grants.
SHA-256 comparison checked 31 maintained root/site files and found 0 missing files and 0 hash differences.
Independent source and extracted-package reruns checked 16 maintained documents and 13 local references with no findings.
Source and extracted-package docs/check_site.py each passed 11 HTML pages.
docs/check_site.py rejects links escaping the deployed docs root; tests.test_site_checker passed the existing-parent-file regression.

The package exposes the Codex marketplace, plugin 3.0.0, $nova entrypoint, 25 Codex roots, complete Claude bundle, 25 Claude folders, 25 Claude ZIPs, Nova Operations, checksums, and styled upgrade, troubleshooting, security, and notices routes.

All 11 desktop pages were visually inspected with no visible clipping, overlap, unreadable hierarchy, or inconsistent navigation. The final 390x844 mobile overview is legible and unclipped. Authoring-cycle CDP metrics reported innerWidth/clientWidth/scrollWidth/bodyScrollWidth=390/390/390/390.

Pages use lang=en, one H1, labelled navigation, skip links, main landmarks, useful image alternatives, scoped table headers, visible focus, reduced-motion handling, responsive navigation, and non-color wording. Structural line contrast is at least 3.38:1.

The journey separates presence, installation, discovery, invocation, behavior, publication, and outcomes, and identifies the six unresolved redistribution components without treating notices as permission.

documentation-project.json now records review-pass-with-conditions, all 27 maintained topics, package parity, authoring evidence, independent review, and the retained untested boundaries; authoring-report.json, task-walkthrough.json, visual-review.json, and codex-cli-surface.json are present.

conditions.affected_claim: Formal accessibility conformance or representative-user usability
conditions.evidence_gap: No screen-reader session, complete keyboard walkthrough, assistive-technology matrix, or representative-user study was retained.
conditions.consequence: This review cannot support a formal conformance claim or claim that every intended user completed the journey.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Before making such a claim, run keyboard-only and representative screen-reader walkthroughs for install, support, security, upgrade, and troubleshooting.
conditions.rerun: Independent accessibility review of the new evidence.

conditions.evidence_gap: Every page has a desktop render, but retained narrow-width rendering and CDP overflow metrics cover the overview only; 200% and 400% zoom were not recorded.
conditions.consequence: Evidence supports the observed overview viewport, not every page at every narrow width or zoom.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Before claiming comprehensive responsive accessibility, exercise support/trust and install/troubleshooting at narrow widths and 200%/400% zoom.
conditions.rerun: Visual and keyboard review of those layouts.

conditions.affected_claim: Live installation, discovery, invocation, and external route availability
conditions.evidence_gap: Package paths and local Codex command syntax were inspected, but no fresh-host Codex or Claude installation was performed and provider-controlled routes were not qualification-tested.
conditions.consequence: Static documentation readiness does not prove live host behavior or continuing external-route availability.
conditions.smallest_next_step: Run a separately authorized fresh-host installation and one real Nova invocation; check support/security routes immediately before publication.
conditions.rerun: Task walkthrough using the live host and observed external routes.

separate_release_gate.note: Public redistribution remains blocked by component terms recorded in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and the package manifest. This does not reduce the documentation-quality verdict.

rerun_triggers: Any rebuilt package whose maintained documentation differs from checkpoint 6151da1862c93e2af1755a5b79aee239816c5d1f
evidence_boundary: Independent review of source and extracted-package documentation, static procedures, local command syntax, retained renders, and deterministic receipts. No fresh-host behavior, assistive-technology session, representative-user outcome, publication, or redistribution authority is established.
